purpose: Verified internship & fellowship tracker for Ricky He. Only live, checked postings go in openings.json. Target companies without a live posting go in watchlist.json.
rules: Never invent a role title or deadline for a company that has no live posting.
listing_status=open requires a posting_url that returns a real job page on verify day.
listing_status=watch is for priority targets not yet posted (expected window + careers URL only).
Fellowships/residencies may be open even when Summer internship postings are not.
Eternity scans must re-verify URLs before promoting watch -> open.
sources_priority: Company careers / Greenhouse / Workday / Lever / Ashby
Community aggregators (cross-check only, never sole source)
